name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Work as a Gallery Assistant, Special Event Staff or Birthday Experience Assistant at the children's museum. You set hours around your school day.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 14 to 17. No experience needed.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Page mentions community service hours or work experience.
duration: Flexible schedule around school. Hours not stated.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Orientations are held twice a month.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online volunteer form on the page. Watch for a confirmation email. Then go to a volunteer orientation, which is a must. Contact Volunteer@DiscoveryKidsLV.org or (702) 382-3445 ext. 110.
notes: The page does not say if a parent must sign. Teen volunteers are not presenters; you can apply for presenter roles at 18.
